{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE RecordWildCards #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Concurrent.STM.TVar
import Control.Monad (when, void, forever)
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Data.ByteString.Lazy (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as BL
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Model registry with versioned weights
data ModelState = ModelState
  { msWeights    :: !(Map.Map Text Double)
  , msVersion    :: !Int
  , msRefCount   :: !Int
  , msCallbacks  :: ![IO ()]
  }

data InferenceServer = InferenceServer
  { isModel      :: !(MVar ModelState)
  , isMetrics    :: !(TVar (Map.Map Text Int))
  , isRateLimit  :: !(IORef (Map.Map Text Int))
  , isHotReload  :: !(MVar Bool)
  }

initServer :: IO InferenceServer
initServer = do
  let initialWeights = Map.fromList [("layer1", 0.5), ("layer2", 0.3), ("bias", 0.1)]
  model <- newMVar $ ModelState initialWeights 1 0 []
  metrics <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  rateLimit <- newIORef Map.empty
  hotReload <- newMVar False
  return $ InferenceServer model metrics rateLimit hotReload

-- Kubernetes liveness probe handler
livenessCheck :: InferenceServer -> IO Bool
livenessCheck srv = do
  canRead <- tryReadMVar (isModel srv)
  case canRead of
    Nothing -> return False
    Just _  -> return True

-- Core inference with model lock acquisition
runInference :: InferenceServer -> Text -> IO (Either Text Double)
runInference srv input = do
  -- Acquire model for inference
  ms <- takeMVar (isModel srv)
  let newMs = ms { msRefCount = msRefCount ms + 1 }
  -- Register completion callback that releases the model
  let callback = releaseModel srv ms
  let msWithCallback = newMs { msCallbacks = callback : msCallbacks newMs }
  putMVar (isModel srv) msWithCallback
  -- Perform inference computation
  result <- computeInference (msWeights msWithCallback) input
  -- Execute post-inference hooks (metrics, cleanup)
  executePostInference srv input msWithCallback
  return result

-- Release model reference - called from callbacks
releaseModel :: InferenceServer -> ModelState -> IO ()
releaseModel srv ms = do
  current <- takeMVar (isModel srv)
  let updated = current { msRefCount = msRefCount current - 1 }
  -- When refcount hits zero during hot-reload, trigger model swap
  when (msRefCount updated <= 0) $ do
    reloading <- readMVar (isHotReload srv)
    when reloading $ do
      -- Perform hot reload while holding the model lock
      newWeights <- loadNewWeights
      let swapped = updated { msWeights = newWeights, msVersion = msVersion updated + 1 }
      putMVar (isModel srv) swapped
      -- Notify watchers - this re-enters the model lock!
      notifyWatchers srv swapped
      return ()
  when (msRefCount updated > 0) $
    putMVar (isModel srv) updated

-- Notify Kubernetes sidecar and metrics collectors
notifyWatchers :: InferenceServer -> ModelState -> IO ()
notifyWatchers srv ms = do
  -- This attempts to read model state for version reporting
  -- REENTRANCY: we already hold isModel via takeMVar in releaseModel
  -- but this path calls takeMVar again through recordMetric
  recordMetric srv "model_version" (msVersion ms)
  mapM_ id (msCallbacks ms)

-- Record metric - acquires model lock to read version for labeling
recordMetric :: InferenceServer -> Text -> Int -> IO ()
recordMetric srv name val = do
  -- Read current model version for metric labels
  modelState <- takeMVar (isModel srv)
  let label = T.concat [name, "_v", T.pack (show (msVersion modelState))]
  putMVar (isModel srv) modelState
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (isMetrics srv) (Map.insert label val)

executePostInference :: InferenceServer -> Text -> ModelState -> IO ()
executePostInference srv input ms = do
  -- Update rate limiting
  modifyIORef' (isRateLimit srv) (Map.insertWith (+) input 1)
  -- Record inference metric
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (isMetrics srv) (Map.insertWith (+) "total_inferences" 1)

computeInference :: Map.Map Text Double -> Text -> IO (Either Text Double)
computeInference weights input = do
  let inputVal = fromIntegral (T.length input) / 100.0
  let result = Map.foldl' (\acc w -> acc + w * inputVal) 0.0 weights
  return $ Right result

loadNewWeights :: IO (Map.Map Text Double)
loadNewWeights = do
  -- Simulate loading from ConfigMap volume mount
  threadDelay 1000
  return $ Map.fromList [("layer1", 0.7), ("layer2", 0.4), ("bias", 0.05)]

-- HTTP handler for k8s service
app :: InferenceServer -> Application
app srv req respond = do
  case pathInfo req of
    ["healthz"] -> do
      alive <- livenessCheck srv
      if alive
        then respond $ responseLBS status200 [] "ok"
        else respond $ responseLBS status503 [] "unhealthy"
    ["predict"] -> do
      body <- strictRequestBody req
      let input = T.pack $ BL.unpack body
      result <- runInference srv input
      case result of
        Right val -> respond $ responseLBS status200 [] (BL.pack $ show val)
        Left err  -> respond $ responseLBS status500 [] (BL.pack $ T.unpack err)
    ["reload"] -> do
      _ <- swapMVar (isHotReload srv) True
      respond $ responseLBS status200 [] "reload scheduled"
    _ -> respond $ responseLBS status404 [] "not found"

main :: IO ()
main = do
  srv <- initServer
  -- Background thread for periodic model refresh (k8s ConfigMap watcher)
  void $ forkIO $ forever $ do
    threadDelay (30 * 1000000)
    reloading <- readMVar (isHotReload srv)
    when reloading $ void $ releaseModel srv (ModelState Map.empty 0 0 [])
  run 8080 (app srv)
